a compact sat encoding for non-preemptiv.description: We propose a novel compact Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) encoding that substantially reduces clauses and auxiliary variables while preserving unit propagation, outperforming commercial MIP solvers on difficult scheduling benchmarks.

efficient sat and maxsat techniques for.description: Presents exact SAT and MaxSAT formulation techniques utilizing order encodings, specialized non-overlapping constraints, and symmetry breaking for 2D Strip Packing, establishing new upper bounds and solving previously open benchmark instances.

an efficient maxsat-ddd approach for tra.description: Develops a Disjunctive Delay Decision (DDD) MaxSAT framework combined with precedence propagation and hybrid At-Most-One encodings for real-time railway train rescheduling under severe network delays.

sequential counter encoding for staircas.description: Introduces a specialized Sequential Counter encoding for staircase overlapping At-Most-One constraint topologies, reducing clause count by up to 40% while preserving unit propagation strength.

an efficient sat encoding for solving th.description: Combines lexicographical symmetry-breaking constraints with compact cardinality formulations to solve the Social Golfer Problem (CSPLib prob027) efficiently.

sat-based approaches for two-dimensional.description: A systematic empirical study comparing modern SAT formulations for 2D Bin Packing against Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) and Constraint Programming (CP) solvers.

solving at-least sequence constraints in.description: Formulates at-least sequence constraints in hospital nurse rostering into SAT, proving faster solving times over traditional integer formulations.

compact sat encoding for power peak mini.description: Compact SAT encodings for non-linear power peak minimization in manufacturing schedules, achieving exact solutions on larger benchmarks than previous mathematical programs.

cycle time minimization for the simple a.description: Addresses simple assembly line balancing (SALBP) subject to station peak power limits, minimizing cycle time via exact discrete modeling.

compact sat and maxsat encodings for bus.description: Formulates B2B meeting scheduling with idle waiting time balance using PySAT and RC2 MaxSAT solvers.

solving the two-dimensional single stock.description: Applies SAT and MaxSAT techniques to the 2D single stock cutting stock problem, comparing pattern generation vs. direct placement models.

sat encodings for bandwidth coloring: a.description: Systematically investigates direct, order, and log encodings for the Bandwidth Coloring Problem, analyzing propagation efficiency trade-offs.

sat encoding for set of at-most-k cardin.description: Extends sequential counter encodings to structured ladder-shaped At-Most-K constraints, minimizing auxiliary variables.

biểu diễn sat tối ưu cho các bài toán tố.description: Luận văn Thạc sĩ Khoa học Máy tính: Tổng hợp các phương pháp biểu diễn SAT tối ưu, lý thuyết rút gọn mệnh đề và đánh giá thực nghiệm trên các bài toán xếp dỡ và điều độ.
